description: This file provides the data access layer for subtitle synchronization backend, defining functions to manage processing status and subtitles in an in-memory database.

methods.name: save_file_processing_status(task_id: str, status: str, error: Optional[str] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Update or insert a processing status entry for a given task ID.

methods.name: get_file_processing_status(task_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve the processing status for a specific task ID.

methods.name: save_subtitles(task_id: str, subtitles: List[dict])
methods.description: Save generated subtitles for a specific task ID.

methods.name: Optional[List[dict]] get_subtitles(task_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve subtitles associated with a task ID.

methods.name: List[str] list_uploaded_files(upload_dir: str)
methods.description: List files present in a specified upload directory.

ctags.name: IN_MEMORY_DB
ctags.pattern: /^IN_MEMORY_DB: Dict[str, dict] = {}  # Maps task_id to status\/subtitle info$/

ctags.name: save_file_processing_status
ctags.pattern: /^def save_file_processing_status(task_id: str, status: str, error: Optional[str] = None, progress/
ctags.signature: (task_id: str, status: str, error: Optional[str] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None)
